notes: Checked against COERLL's own Spanish listing page only. Each title carries its own licence label: CC-BY-NC-SA (Así me expreso, Estamos aquí!, Spanish Grammar in Context, SpinTX Video Archive), CC-BY-SA (Hecho en Texas, an adaptation of Trayectos, and Trayectos), CC-BY (Spanish Proficiency Exercises, ¡Listos!, Recorridos por la literatura hispana, the Heritage Spanish modules), CC-BY-NC-ND and CC-BY-NC on two assessment tools. So the licence is per title and a link is all an app may do. The listing gives no licence version, and each title's own site (several on other hosts) wasn't read, so a label here isn't proof of that title's licence; the video collections show native speakers and may carry their own terms. COERLL's Site Policies link goes to www.utexas.edu, which wasn't reachable, so site-wide terms weren't read. Several titles are intermediate or heritage-speaker level. Portuguese and German titles are on other COERLL listing pages and aren't covered by this record. A CC BY or CC BY-SA title could become its own entry once its own pages are read. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
